findings.title: Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) exceeds 2.5s
findings.description: LCP of 4200ms is classified as 'poor' by Core Web Vitals. The main content takes too long to become visible to users.
findings.recommendation: Optimize the hero image with modern formats (WebP/AVIF), implement preload hints, and reduce server response time.

findings.title: Total Blocking Time (TBT) exceeds 200ms
findings.description: TBT of 580ms indicates the main thread is blocked for extended periods, preventing user interaction.
findings.recommendation: Break up long tasks, defer non-critical JavaScript, and use web workers for heavy computation.

findings.title: Eliminate render-blocking resources
findings.description: 3 stylesheets and 2 scripts block page rendering. These resources must be downloaded and processed before the page can be painted.
findings.recommendation: Inline critical CSS, defer non-critical stylesheets, and add async/defer attributes to scripts.

findings.title: Background and foreground colors do not have sufficient contrast ratio
findings.description: Some text elements have a contrast ratio below the WCAG AA minimum of 4.5:1, making them difficult to read for users with low vision.
findings.recommendation: Increase color contrast to meet WCAG AA (4.5:1 for normal text).

findings.title: Document does not have a meta description
findings.description: Meta descriptions are used by search engines to generate snippets. Missing descriptions reduce click-through rates from search results.
findings.recommendation: Add a unique, compelling meta description (120-160 characters) to each page.

findings.title: Links do not have a discernible name
findings.description: 3 links are missing accessible names, making them impossible for screen reader users to identify.
findings.recommendation: Add text content, aria-label, or aria-labelledby to all links.

findings.title: Uses deprecated APIs
findings.description: Page calls 2 deprecated JavaScript APIs that will be removed in future browser versions.
findings.recommendation: Replace deprecated APIs with modern equivalents. Check browser compatibility before removing fallbacks.

findings.title: Missing CSP header
findings.description: Content Security Policy header is not set, leaving the site vulnerable to XSS attacks.
findings.recommendation: Implement a Content-Security-Policy header with appropriate directives.

opportunities.title: Serve images in next-gen formats
opportunities.description: Image formats like WebP and AVIF often provide better compression than PNG or JPEG, resulting in faster downloads.

opportunities.title: Enable text compression
opportunities.description: Text-based resources should be served with gzip or Brotli compression to reduce transfer size.

opportunities.title: Reduce unused JavaScript
opportunities.description: 3 JavaScript bundles contain unused code that can be tree-shaken or code-split.
